name: Arcane Safeguard

source.note: Compared with the published D&D Beyond chapter on 2026-10-06: https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/au/chapter-1-character-options.

summary: Always prepared: Resistance; choose Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma for casting. Cast Resistance as a Bonus Action Proficiency Bonus times per Long Rest. Help that assists an ally's ability check also grants it Temporary Hit Points equal to your Proficiency Bonus.

benefits.name: Resistance
benefits.summary: Always prepared: Resistance; choose Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma for casting.
benefits.text: Always prepared: Resistance; choose Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma for casting.

benefits.name: Safeguarding Help
benefits.summary: When your Help assists an ally's ability check, that ally also gains Temporary Hit Points equal to your Proficiency Bonus.
benefits.text: When you take the Help action to assist an ally's ability check, that ally also gains Temporary Hit Points equal to your Proficiency Bonus. The game has no Help for ability checks yet (in a fight, Help assists attack rolls), so this part is played out at the table.

benefits.name: Quick Ward
benefits.summary: Cast Resistance as a Bonus Action, Proficiency Bonus times per Long Rest.
benefits.text: You can cast Resistance with a Bonus Action instead of an action, a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus; you regain all uses on a Long Rest.
